gist.headline: Cats, now sticker-shaped
gist.blurb: A new community app turns real cat photos into WeChat-style cartoon stickers. The internet has found another efficient way to preserve feline expressions forever.
gist.summary: Added the Cat Sticker Generator community app, which analyzes uploaded cat photos for breed, fur color, eye color, and patterns to create WeChat-style cartoon stickers.
gist.impact: People can now turn a favorite cat photo into a personalized cartoon sticker through a listed pollinations.ai community app.
